name: Hōki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hōki town emblem in green and blue: a green stylised mountain within green and blue elliptical strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Hōki, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2005.

features.role: Hōki town emblem — a green stylised mountain within green and blue elliptical strokes
